check: (kube_job_failed{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~@job_name,job_name=~"intsec-sync-[0-9]+",condition="true"} and on (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time == on (namespace) group_left max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~"intsec-sync-[0-9]+"}))) or on (namespace) (0 * max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~"intsec-sync-[0-9]+"}))
steps:
With the factory kubeconfig, run `kubectl -n <namespace> logs job/<job_name>`
using the namespace and Job name in the alert summary. The alert clears when a
newer sync Job starts unless that Job also fails.
